_provenance.terrain: historical: coastline, relief and rivers simplified from present-day geography (the modern coast is close enough at this scale; the Po delta and the Tuscan and Latin coastal plains have moved by a few kilometres since antiquity, under one tile here). designed: the simplification itself, drawn by hand as the polygons and polylines in tools/Italy/build_italy.py. Built by tools/Italy/build_italy.py into tools/Italy/italy-500bc.png and imported with tools/TerrainImport.
_provenance.width: designed: 11.6 degrees of longitude (7 E to 18.6 E) at 12 tiles per degree; the Balkan shore beyond is drawn as sea.
_provenance.height: designed: 9.7 degrees of latitude (36.6 N to 46.3 N, the Alpine crest) at 16 tiles per degree, so tiles are about 6.9 km square; Africa is drawn as sea.
_provenance.tileTypes: designed: the twelve terrain types of the classical world, reused unchanged so the ruleset's costs apply. Forest stands for wooded hill country, as in the original.
_provenance.lakes: historical: Benacus, Larius, Verbanus, Sebinus, Trasumennus, Volsiniensis, Sabatinus and Fucinus (Pliny, Natural History 2.224, 3.131; Livy 22.4 on Trasumennus). Fucinus was drained in the 1870s. designed: their simplified outlines.
_provenance.turnOrder: designed: the nations in the order of NATIONS in tools/Italy/build_italy.py.
_provenance.startingRelations: designed: peace everywhere except these wars. rome-etruria: historical: Rome's wars with Veii and Porsenna in the first years of the Republic (Livy 2.6-2.15, 2.42-2.53). magnagraecia-etruria: historical: Aristodemus of Cumae fought the Etruscans at Cumae (524 BC) and Aricia (c. 504 BC) (Dionysius of Halicarnassus 7.3-7.6; Livy 2.14). syracuse-carthage: historical: the Sicilian Greeks' wars with Carthage, which ended at Himera in 480 BC (Herodotus 7.165-7.167). designed: at war from the start. samnites-campanians: designed: the Samnites' push into Campania, which took Capua in 423 BC (Livy 4.37), begun early.
_provenance.weatherCentres: designed: twenty points of open sea, each at least 10 tiles from the edge, for the rough-sea overlay.
_provenance.startingFleets: designed: one fleet each for the sea powers.
